title: Error Messages
concept: Good error messages include what went wrong, why it happened, and how to fix it — turning frustrating crashes into actionable guidance.
why: Developers spend 30-50% of debugging time understanding error messages. Clear, actionable messages dramatically reduce time-to-fix.
tips: Include the ACTUAL value that caused the error — not just what was expected
Suggest a fix when the path forward is clear — this saves hours of investigation
Keep messages concise but complete — aim for 1-3 sentences maximum
Error messages are UX for developers — invest time in making them helpful
common_mistakes: Error messages that don't include the offending value — the developer has to reproduce to see it
Passing raw internal state to users — sanitize but keep actionable details
Writing error messages that only the original author understands
